body.statement: Uniformly over \(2\le d\le n\) and \(0\le\sigma\le2\) satisfying \(\sigma^2d^2\le n\), \[\mathsf R_{n,d,\epsilon,M,\sigma}\asymp_{\epsilon}M^2/n.\] In particular, for \(d=\lfloor n^{3/4}\rfloor\) and \(\sigma^2=u_{n,d}\), the minimax MSE is of order \(M^2/n\).
body.justification: This records the empirical-mass-improved subregion as a theorem-level deliverable rather than leaving it implicit in a global open question.
body.gap: The accepted parent leaves a polynomial gap on the displayed \(n^{3/4}\) sequence; the exact empirical-mass estimator closes it on the full class.
body.consumer: It gives a directly checkable sufficient condition under which approximate common effects retain collision-scale estimation.
